lessons.why: MS-700 is still live, with a skills update on Oct 27 2026; it is NOT retired and has no replacement.
body: MS-700 is still live, with a skills update on Oct 27 2026; it is NOT retired and has no replacement. Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate is earned with MS-700. The certification page, checked for this campus on 14 October 2026, does not name a successor. Third-party claims that an MS-220 collaboration exam replaced it are not what Learn showed on that date.

The exam includes network planning and call-quality troubleshooting, not only meetings. Passing score is 700. Role certifications also expire unless you pass the free renewal. Expiry is not the same event as Microsoft retiring the exam.

lessons.title: MB-280, AB-210, and AB-250
lessons.why: These three numbers get swapped in job posts. Only one of them is the contact-center exam.
body: MB-280 retired Jul 31 2026, with AB-210 as its successor; AB-210 is in beta. MB-280, Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst, was Sales and Customer Insights, not Contact Center. AB-210 is Dynamics 365 Sales AI Consultant. It does not replace MS-700.
AB-250 is Transforming Contact Center Experiences with AI in Dynamics 365. That is the contact-center certification. A study plan that points a queue engineer at AB-210 is the wrong pile of work.
lessons.say: MB-280 retired Jul 31 2026, with AB-210 as its successor; AB-210 is in beta. AB-250 is the contact-center exam.
lessons.fault: A job post requires MB-280 after the retirement date, or a contact-center candidate studies AB-210.
lessons.listen: MB-280 retired Jul 31 2026, with AB-210 as its successor; AB-210 is in beta. AB-250 is the contact-center exam. AB-210 does not replace MS-700.

lessons.title: AZ-900 and SC-900
lessons.why: Fundamentals help with Azure and identity vocabulary. They do not make you a voice engineer.
depends: Honesty about what an exam covers
body: AZ-900, Azure Fundamentals, was not on the retirement list reviewed on 14 October 2026. SC-900, Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals, is live and the English certification is scheduled to update on 21 October 2026. MS-900 retired on 31 March 2026. AI-900 retired on 30 June 2026.
Use AZ-900 if you need Azure words for ACS and Speech. Use SC-900 if you need Entra and compliance words for Conditional Access and recording’s trust boundary. Neither one replaces MS-700 or AB-250.
lessons.say: AZ-900 and SC-900 are context. MS-900 and AI-900 are retired. The role exams still matter.
lessons.fault: A voice design is accepted because someone passed AZ-900.
lessons.listen: AZ-900 and SC-900 are optional context. They are not the voice exam or the contact-center exam.

lessons.title: Learning paths that match the job
lessons.why: A random trail of modules will not assemble a dial plan in your head.
depends: The track order of this campus
body: Follow the same order as this campus: tenant and licenses, network, connectivity, routing, voice apps, emergency, SBC, then the contact center. Microsoft Learn modules exist for Teams Phone, Direct Routing, QoS, and the AB-250 course family. Use them as the official wording beside these notes.
When a module and this page disagree, the module accessed the week you need it wins. This page was checked on 14 October 2026.

flow.label: Contact center
flow.detail: After the phone system is real

lessons.say: I study foundations, then the phone system, then the contact center. I re-read Learn when I am about to change production.
lessons.fault: Someone starts with a bot and has no emergency route.
lessons.listen: Learn the tenant, the network, and the PSTN path before the bot. Re-check Learn before you change production.

lessons.title: The status board
lessons.why: Dates are the part that makes a certification answer true or false.
body: MS-700 is still live, with a skills update on Oct 27 2026; it is NOT retired and has no replacement. MB-280 retired Jul 31 2026, with AB-210 as its successor; AB-210 is in beta. Also on the board: MS-900 retired 31 March 2026, AI-900 retired 30 June 2026, AB-250’s public beta discount ran through 18 June 2026, and SC-900’s English update is scheduled for 21 October 2026. Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert is scheduled to retire on 30 November 2026, which is not the Teams voice exam.
This is a status board, not a product-release myth. Direct Routing’s current proxies and ports come from the plan page, not from a memory of a launch year.
lessons.say: MS-700 is still live, with a skills update on Oct 27 2026; it is NOT retired and has no replacement. MB-280 retired Jul 31 2026, with AB-210 as its successor; AB-210 is in beta.
lessons.fault: An undated blog retires MS-700 and the candidate believes it.

lessons.title: How to use the readiness map
lessons.why: A self-rating is useful only if a low score points at a lesson.
body: Rate yourself 0 to 3 on the live exams. Anything under 2 on MS-700, AB-250, AZ-900, or SC-900 is a study target, not a personality result. AB-210 is a target only if the job is Sales. MB-280, MS-900, and AI-900 are not targets.
The rating stays in this browser. It is not an account and not a certificate. Book the exam only after you re-open the study guide.

chart.title: What a 2 means
chart.note: Your rating, not a score from Microsoft.

lessons.say: A readiness score is mine, in this browser, and the study guide still wins.
lessons.fault: Someone books the exam because a slider felt high.
lessons.listen: Use the readiness map to find gaps. Then re-read the official study guide before you schedule anything.
